WITH __slayer_stage_s1 AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.region_id" AS "customers__region_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.revenue" AS "revenue"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.region_id AS "orders.customers.region_id",
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      customers.region_id,
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."s1.customers__region_id" AS "customers__region_id",
    _stage_inner."s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id" AS "revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s1.customers__region_id AS "s1.customers__region_id",
      SUM(s1.revenue) AS "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id"
    FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
    GROUP BY
      s1.customers__region_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), base AS (
  SELECT
    s1.customers__region_id AS "s1.customers__region_id",
    s1.customer_id AS "s1.customer_id",
    _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id" AS "s1.region_revenue",
    CAST(SUM(s1.revenue) AS DOUBLE) AS "s1.cust_revenue"
  FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
  LEFT JOIN _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id
    ON s1.customers__region_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."customers__region_id"
  GROUP BY
    s1.customers__region_id,
    s1.customer_id,
    _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "s1.customers__region_id",
    "s1.customer_id",
    "s1.region_revenue",
    "s1.cust_revenue",
    CASE
      WHEN "s1.cust_revenue" IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "s1.customers__region_id", CASE WHEN "s1.cust_revenue" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ORDER BY "s1.cust_revenue" DESC
      )
    END AS "s1.rk"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  "s1.customers__region_id",
  "s1.customer_id",
  "s1.region_revenue",
  "s1.cust_revenue",
  "s1.rk"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "s1.customers__region_id",
    "s1.customer_id",
    "s1.region_revenue",
    "s1.cust_revenue",
    "s1.rk"
  FROM step1
  WHERE
    "s1.rk" <= 2
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "s1.customers__region_id" ASC,
  "s1.cust_revenue" DESC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Revenue is the sum of order amounts across all orders, whatever their status. I grouped customers by their region and left out anyone without one, including orders whose customer id doesn't match any customer. In each region I ranked customers by revenue and kept the top two; there were no ties. Each region's total covers all of its customers' orders. Region 5 (Arctic) isn't listed because none of its customers have orders.
